title: wavCSE canonical Paper admission attempt
description: One append-only provenance record of an attempt to admit a discovered CandidatePaper as a canonical Paper. The Paper's identity and bibliography live in catalog.jsonl and its canonical card; this row only records where the bibliographic identity came from (discovery provider and provider record id), the normalized identifiers considered, the outcome and a bounded detail. It never stores credentials, headers or raw provider payloads.

admission_id.description: deterministic identity of the attempt, from its inputs only

recorded_at.description: ISO 8601 UTC instant the attempt was recorded

kind.description: the structured failure kind for a REJECTED attempt, null otherwise

matched_field.description: the strongest identity field that matched an existing Paper for KNOWN
